name: Plop
description:
A grub dropped out of the broodling's vent onto the ground. It played the spit's chirp before, which said a shot was fired when nothing was: the grub is laid, not launched, and it crawls the rest of the way.

So this is a small wet body landing. `drop` is a sine whose pitch rises rather than falls — the sound a drop makes is the air pocket under it closing, and that closes upward — from `$shell` to a little over `$shell.up`, struck in three milliseconds. A sine because the grub is soft: an edge on it would read as chitin. `slap` is the contact, a few milliseconds of noise under a lowpass at `$grit`, so the plop has a front on a phone, where the sine alone is a little thin.

Soft and short: it repeats on the vent's cooldown for the whole run, and it is the least urgent thing the weapons say.
